summary: Payments platform for accepting payments, billing, invoicing, payouts and issuing cards online.
access_note: Free Stripe account with sandboxes; secret or restricted API keys created in the Dashboard. OAuth for MCP and Connect platforms.

evidence.quote: Provide your API key as the basic auth username value.
Use OAuth when a client accesses Stripe on behalf of your Stripe user account.
You can use the Stripe API in sandboxes without affecting your live data or interacting with banking networks.
The Stripe API is organized around REST
Stripe's MCP server supports two authentication methods

notes: Stripe MCP will stop accepting full-access secret keys from 2027-01-11 (agent API keys or OAuth only); OAuth refresh tokens expire after 14 days. Multi-tenant use of OAuth for end users goes through Stripe Connect/Apps, not reviewed here.

review.reason: REST quote carried a trailing period the page does not have in plain text; MCP quote truncated mid-sentence.
